Where do you submit test reports?
ovos-tui never submits anything: it only builds a link that opens the store's page with your report
filled in. You check it there and submit it yourself.
Paste the report link from your skill store's instructions (it contains {report_fragment} or {report}).
Skip if you don't use one: you still get a link to the report itself, and this is asked again next time.
Change it any time: Ctrl+P → 'Settings: Skill store report link'. Kept in
ype what you'd say to OVOS...
